profile_text.body:
Meta is a public company founded in 2004, headquartered in Menlo Park, California, and traded under the ticker META. Its most recent 10-K, covering the period ending December 31, 2025, reported revenue of $200,966,000,000. Its developer site presents Meta's AI models and tools for developers, centered on Muse Spark, which the company describes as tuned for long-horizon coding workflows with fewer unnecessary turns and cleaner output, and as performing competitively with frontier models across several coding evals. Muse Spark is reached through Muse Code and the Meta Model API, which the site says can be used by pointing an existing OpenAI SDK compatible client at it, and which supports search grounding for live web access through a single tool added to a request. The site also lists Muse Image on the Meta Model API at $0.01/image, described as a reasoning model that plans layout before drawing, with anchored composition for consistent edits. A separate product listing covers Llama (Meta), an open-weight model family that is often self-hosted.

Litigation held on the company includes Neural AI, LLC v. Meta Platforms, Inc. in the District Court, W.D. Texas; Chicken Soup for the Soul, LLC v. Meta Platforms Inc. in the District Court, N.D. California; and Kadrey v. Meta Platforms, Inc. in the U.S. District Court, N.D. California. The recorded exposure count for California is 270.

Several MCP servers are associated with Meta's advertising and related tooling. These include ai.adweave/meta-ads-mcp, described as a Meta Ads MCP server with 47 tools for campaigns, creatives, audiences, and insights; co.pipeboard/meta-ads-mcp, for Facebook and Meta Ads automation with AI; and com.adbloop/meta-ads, for bulk creation of Facebook and Instagram ads across accounts from Drive folders. Others listed are ai.fastmetal/fastmetal for running and comparing LLMs and generating images and video, ai.livingmeta/ai-in-research, a read-only MCP over a corpus of 12,400 papers, ai.primeta/primeta for 3D avatars with custom personas, and app.metadock/metadock for controlling a desktop workspace.
